races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Joga Bonito
runners_data.comment: Plenty of speed but didn't stay 7.5f on debut; drop back in trip should suit

runners_data.name: Citrus Springs

runners_data.spotlight: Olympiad filly cost 65,000USD as a yearling and 300,000USD at the breeze-ups; half-sister to US winners Spirit Maker (1m-1m1f turf inc 2yo) and Not Guilty (5f AW); dam once-raced half-sister to US 8.5f Grade 2 winner Protonico, is granddaughter of US 8.5f Grade 1 winner Wild Spirit; very interesting debutante, likely has ground to suit (holds Group entry next month).

runners_data.name: Pisiffik Ginger
runners_data.comment: Cotai Glory filly cost 22,000euros as a foal; market best guide on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Cotai Glory filly cost 22,000euros as a foal; first foal; dam 1m winner (RPR 90), half-sister to 1m3f/12.4f winner Sportingsilvermine; market best guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Magical Moonlight
runners_data.comment: Yard having a good season so respected but but juveniles tend to benefit from a run
runners_data.spotlight: Invincible Army filly cost 12,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to Italian 6f winner Nalu; dam Group-placed 6f 2yo winner (RPR 96), closely related to 5.5f 2yo winner Miss Rosina; yard having a good season so respected but but juveniles tend to benefit from a run.

runners_data.name: Tatianna
runners_data.comment: Encouraging debut in similar 5f race at Cork nine days ago but plenty more likely needed
runners_data.spotlight: Kameko filly; 20,000euros foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Qaroun (useful 7f/1m) and Puerto De Vega (6f/7f); encouraging debut in similar 5f race at Cork nine days ago but plenty more likely needed here.

runners_data.name: I Ready
runners_data.comment: Slow to break and green, not disgraced in the circumstances on Curragh debut last Saturday
runners_data.spotlight: Invincible Army gelding; 10,000euros yearling; second foal; dam runner-up 6f 2yo (RPR 74), half-sister to winners Insignia Of Rank (1m Listed) and Mayleaf Shine (useful 5f inc 2yo); slow to break and green, not disgraced in the circumstances on Curragh debut last Saturday; quick return and should have learnt a lot.

runners_data.name: Lars Soldier
runners_data.comment: Too keen in Marble Hill on Sunday; tries 6f again but needs to settle better
runners_data.spotlight: All three runs have been at the Curragh, big improvement second occasion to beat two subsequent winners in 5f maiden on testing ground; upped to 6f in Group 3 Marble Hill on Sunday, not doing himself justice on quicker ground after racing keenly when beaten over 6l; persisted with at this trip, needs to settle better.

runners_data.name: High King
runners_data.comment: Never sighted on debut in Curragh maiden early this month; sure to come on from that
runners_data.spotlight: Calyx colt; price rose from 55,000euros as a foal to 150,000gns as a yearling; closely related to 7f 2yo winner Look Around (inc Listed; RPR 105), half-brother to four winners inc Sara Lucille (French Group-placed 5f inc 2yo; 100); dam 2yo Group 3 winner; 10/1, green when never sighted on debut in Curragh maiden early this month; sure to come on from that.

runners_data.name: Granite Mountain
runners_data.comment: Last of 7 on Curragh debut on opening day of the season in testing conditions
runners_data.spotlight: Last of 7 on Curragh debut on opening day of the season in testing conditions; best watched.

races.name: Royal County Optional Claiming Race

runners_data.name: Tawaazon
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 307-day absence that undermines his chances despite past course form and suitable style.
runners_data.comment: 9-time winner absent since July and looks to have a bit to find with some of these
runners_data.spotlight: Durable sort; gained the most recent of his nine wins at Naas a year ago before good third at the Curragh; absent since July and looks to have a bit to find with some of these.

runners_data.name: Gloriously Glam
runners_data.note: Front-running style perfectly suited to dominate this field, racing off quick 8-day turnaround after comfortable Gowran victory.
runners_data.comment: Recent Gowran claiming win over Profit Surge at 7f; drop in trip a slight concern
runners_data.spotlight: Was gaining a fourth career win when landing similar 7f contest at Gowran eight days ago, beating Profit Surge a shade cosily; similar terms with that rival here but shorter trip a slight concern.

runners_data.name: Three Sixteen
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage with new hood suggesting attitude concerns after 268-day break.
runners_data.comment: Three ordinary maiden runs last season; hooded on return for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Given a mark of 67 after three maiden runs in second half of last season over different trips; hooded on return for new yard.

runners_data.name: Spirit Of Eagles
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with recent Sligo placing form but faces wrong race shape against uncontested pace-setter.
runners_data.comment: Recent Sligo run her best for some time but lots on at the weights here
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came over 5f at Down Royal three years ago; best run for some time when placed in Sligo handicap early this month off basement mark of 40; plenty on at the weights against most of her rivals here.

runners_data.name: Mehmar
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits but regressing form and 57-day break suggests unlikely to pressure Gloriously Glam effectively.
runners_data.comment: Regressive 6yo; visor replaces cheekpieces and looks to have something to find.
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over this trip for Michael O'Callaghan on turf in 2024, showing a liking for quick ground; placed in AW claimer over the winter but generally regressive; visor replaces cheekpieces here and looks to have something to find.

runners_data.name: Profit Surge
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who ran well behind Gloriously Glam at Gowran but faces similar tactical disadvantage on 8-day turnaround.
runners_data.comment: Second to Gloriously Glam in 7f claimer 8 days ago; same terms and now blinkered
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden was placed three times in AW handicaps last winter and ran well above her handicap mark when pushing Gloriously Glam close in 7f Gowran claimer eight days ago, albeit when allowed to dictate a steady pace; handicap mark has gone up 9lb but meets that rival on same terms here; blinkers now tried and drops in trip.

runners_data.name: Lismacbryan
runners_data.note: Prominent style undermined by tendency to fade in finish and poor recent form despite 12-day freshness.
runners_data.comment: Would be much better off with all of these in a handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came over this trip in Curragh handicap in 2024; good second in first-time cheekpieces at Naas last summer but little since; would be much better off with all of these in a handicap.

races.paceDynamic: Gloriously Glam will dominate the early pace from the front with minimal pressure from the prominent runners Tawaazon, Mehmar and Lismacbryan who all lack recent competitive form or early tactical speed. The modest field size and single confirmed pace-setter creates a controlled tempo that will build gradually rather than collapse dramatically. Hold-up horses like Three Sixteen, Spirit Of Eagles and Profit Surge face the dual challenge of overcoming both the sustainable pace and significant class/form deficits. This race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent racers who can stay close to Gloriously Glam's controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Gloriously Glam Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Gloriously Glam gets an uncontested lead and maintains her recent Gowran form.
scenarios.body: She dictates throughout on the front end while the held-up horses struggle to make meaningful ground against her controlled but relentless gallop. The lack of early pressure allows her to conserve energy for a strong finish that the trailing pack cannot match.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Tawaazon or Mehmar show improved form and press Gloriously Glam early.
scenarios.body: The increased pace pressure forces a genuine speed duel that could set up the race for a closer or late-running type. Gloriously Glam's recent exertions at Gowran may tell if forced to work harder than ideal.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Long Absence Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Tawaazon's 307-day layoff shows as he fails to provide any early competition.
scenarios.body: Gloriously Glam gets an even easier lead than expected while the other prominent types also disappoint, leaving the field strung out with no genuine pace pressure. The hold-up horses still lack the class to capitalize despite the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Class Collapse Opens Door
scenarios.trigger: If Gloriously Glam fails to reproduce her Gowran form after quick reappearance.
scenarios.body: The entire complexion changes with no genuine pace-setter emerging, creating a messy tactical affair where any horse showing improved form could capitalize. Spirit Of Eagles' recent Sligo placing or Profit Surge's Gowran effort could prove decisive.

watchPoints.text: Gloriously Glam must break cleanly to establish her front-running position without early interference from the prominent types.
Tawaazon's early positioning will reveal if his long absence has left him sharp enough to provide genuine pace pressure.
Three Sixteen's new headgear change suggests attitude issues that could manifest as reluctance or over-racing.
Spirit Of Eagles needs the pace to collapse early to have any realistic chance from his hold-up style.
Profit Surge's ability to settle closer than at Gowran could determine if she can reverse that form with Gloriously Glam.

races.name: Fiver Fridays At Fairyhouse June 5th And 12th Handicap

runners_data.name: Absoluteassignment

races.paceDynamic: Absoluteassignment will lead uncontested from the gates with no other confirmed front-runners in the field. The real battle develops behind as Treasured Royal, All Hail, Jackie Jump Up, Baiana, Reimagined, Gonna Be Golden and Girl Bear all want prominent positions, creating a dangerous squeeze 2-3 furlongs out. This congestion will force some of these prominent runners to check or go wide, while hold-up horses Jampa Ling and Stone Bear get a perfect tow into the race. The uncontested leader and tactical hold-up horses benefit most from this shape.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Absoluteassignment gets easy fractions without pressure from the prominent pack.
scenarios.body: The leader gets perfect splits and kicks clear when the prominent runners clash behind. Absoluteassignment's 20lb weight advantage and tongue-tie addition could spark improvement.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates maximum interference and checking 2f out.
scenarios.body: Stone Bear and Jampa Ling get ideal position as the prominent pack tangles ahead. The hold-up pair sweep through late as prominent runners pay for their early exertions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Prominent Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Treasured Royal or Baiana secure ideal position just off the pace without trouble.
scenarios.body: These fillies have the class edge and their connections know how to place them. Treasured Royal's recent hood success or Baiana's maiden win form proves too strong late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Reimagined Finds Improvement
scenarios.trigger: If the ex-Johnson Houghton runner recaptures his Windsor maiden-winning form on these conditions.
scenarios.body: Reimagined drops 8lb from his poor Irish debut and gets perfect good ground. His English form gives him a class edge if the stable has him ready.

watchPoints.text: Treasured Royal, Baiana, Jackie Jump Up and Girl Bear all want the same prominent spot - expect severe checking 2-3f out
Absoluteassignment's 122lb minimum weight and huge odds suggest stable expectations are rock bottom despite perfect tactical position
Stone Bear gets Siobhan Rutledge's 3lb claim and hold-up style that perfectly suits this pace shape
All Hail returns after 319 days off in a race requiring sharp early speed to secure position
Reimagined drops to OR 73 having won off OR 75 at Windsor - significant handicapping edge if ready

races.paceDynamic: Harry Longabaugh is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 21-runner field, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure. The prominent runners like Are You In Or Out, I'm Spartacus, Apache Star and Jazzy Dancer will likely track him in the second rank, but won't force the pace early. This sets up a steady gallop that will quicken late as the large field of hold-up horses including El Fontenaro, Son Of Wind, Happy Henry and Green Icon come with their runs. The lack of pace pressure strongly favours horses that can produce a sharp turn of foot from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Longabaugh is allowed to dictate without early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace will be modest until the final 2f when the race explodes as 15+ hold-up horses unleash their runs simultaneously. This strongly suits the classier hold-up performers who can quicken best when the race becomes a sprint.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracking Success
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners position perfectly behind the uncontested leader
scenarios.body: Are You In Or Out and I'm Spartacus get first run on the field from their tracking positions while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic. The moderate pace allows these handy types to kick clear before the back-markers organize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-To-Wire Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Longabaugh gets completely uncontested fractions and keeps finding
scenarios.body: The front-runner steals such a march that even when the field quickens, his head start proves decisive in a major upset. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to reserve energy for a sustained kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Longshot
scenarios.trigger: If the 21-runner field creates a cavalry charge with significant interference
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery as multiple horses get hampered in the straight, allowing a well-positioned outsider to emerge from the chaos. This benefits horses drawn to avoid the worst of the scrimmaging.

watchPoints.text: Harry Longabaugh could steal this if allowed completely uncontested fractions with no early pace pressure
Traffic problems are likely with 21 runners over 6f - watch for horses getting hampered in the straight
Are You In Or Out's market movement will reveal stable confidence after long absence and trainer change
El Fontenaro and Happy Henry both have finishing kicks that could be lethal if the pace collapses
Late scratches could significantly alter the pace dynamics if any prominent runners are withdrawn

races.paceDynamic: Venetian Star will be the lone pace-setter early, with Royal County Glory and Merry Blacksmith settling in prominent positions behind. With limited early speed in this field, Venetian Star can dictate comfortable fractions without pressure through the first 5f. The lack of pace pressure means hold-up horses like Fortuity, Thirsty Owl and One Cool Bear will have work to do from off the pace. This sustainable pace setup strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick, rather than hold-up horses who need a strong gallop to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Venetian Star Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Venetian Star gets easy lead fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The front-runner can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back, while prominent trackers get perfect trips to challenge. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against the controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Royal County Glory or Merry Blacksmith get perfect stalking trips behind uncontested leader
scenarios.body: The patient prominent horses can time their challenge perfectly and sweep past a tired leader in final furlong. Their tactical positioning proves decisive over the 7f trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rallies
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and creates a sprint finish scenario
scenarios.body: Late closers like Fortuity and One Cool Bear get the strong finish they need to unleash their turn of foot. The slow early tempo allows them to overcome their tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to fire or encounter trouble in running
scenarios.body: Lightly weighted horses like Lady Kelly or improving types like Chapel Island can exploit the tactical setup. The moderate pace allows lesser lights to stay competitive throughout.

watchPoints.text: Venetian Star could steal this if getting uncontested lead with Patrick McGettigan's 5lb claim helping
Royal County Glory returning to turf after AW success, Julian Pietropaolo's 7lb claim significant factor
Fortuity's tendency to fade in finish could be exposed if pace is too slow for hold-up horses
Merry Blacksmith's keen racing style needs monitoring, trainer-jockey combination Andrew Slattery rides own
Several hold-up horses like Thirsty Owl and One Cool Bear need stronger pace than Venetian Star likely to provide

races.paceDynamic: Out On Friday provides the sole confirmed pace angle as the only natural front runner, likely to dictate terms without serious early pressure from the 16-runner field. Smithfield, Shanlieve, She's Ideal, Casheldale Lass and Proleek Prince should track prominently but won't challenge for the lead early. The sustained tempo will create a searching test over 1m2f on good ground, with the pace likely to be honest rather than frantic. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish late, as the lone leader may weaken in the final stages and prominent racers will have worked harder than usual.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Out On Friday sets steady fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of late runners prove decisive as prominent horses tire from tracking the lone leader over this staying trip. Hold-up specialists get first run on a weakening field in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners settles better than expected behind Out On Friday
scenarios.body: Casheldale Lass or She's Ideal travel smoothly in behind before quickening past the tiring leader. Their tactical positioning proves optimal when late runners are left with too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Out On Friday finds renewed stamina and the pace proves insufficient to stop him
scenarios.body: The veteran's class and course experience (two previous wins here at 1m4f) shine through as he kicks clear turning for home. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground on good going that suits the leader.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes extremely slow with multiple horses challenging Out On Friday
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops from the two-furlong pole as the field remains tightly bunched. The fastest finishers benefit from the lack of early pace and strong stamina becomes less important.

watchPoints.text: Out On Friday must be monitored early as the sole pace angle - if he breaks slowly or gets headed, the race dynamics change completely
Bright N Shine has been absent 374 days which creates significant fitness concerns despite her course and distance credentials
Perfect Judgement and Rising Sky are both stepping up in trip having shown their best form at shorter distances
Several runners including Proleek Prince and Anchors Away show patterns of fading in the finish, making their prominent positions risky
First-time headgear on Je Suis Celebre and Hosanna Power could spark improvement but both need to overcome poor recent efforts

races.paceDynamic: Mathoura will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, likely getting an uncontested lead with Purely sitting second early. The pace should be steady rather than fierce given the lack of pace pressure, allowing Mathoura to dictate terms through sensible fractions over this stamina-testing 1m2f trip. Mai Dahlia, Guardian Of Realm, and the newcomer Mandara Mist will need to overcome their hold-up styles against what shapes as a tactical tempo. This pace scenario clearly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the sprint finish that hold-up horses require.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Mathoura Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Mathoura gets soft fractions and maintains her gallop
scenarios.body: She can use her proven front-running style to full advantage, staying on strongly when the hold-up horses make their moves too late. Purely could benefit from tracking the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mandara Mist Class Tells
scenarios.trigger: If the well-bred newcomer shows natural ability and adapts quickly
scenarios.body: Her superior breeding (half-sister to Group performers) could overcome tactical disadvantage, with jockey Lee finding a way to get competitive. The pace may not be strong enough to set up hold-up horses ideally.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stronger than expected and sets up closers
scenarios.body: Mai Dahlia and Guardian Of Realm could capitalize on their finishing kicks, with the O'Brien second string potentially improving for the step up in trip. Hold-up specialists would benefit from a genuine gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Purely Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the Ballydoyle filly improves dramatically for the trip change
scenarios.body: Her previous efforts suggest she needs everything to fall right, but the stable knows how to place fillies and this represents a significant step up in distance. Front runners might fade if pressed.

watchPoints.text: Mathoura must be watched for any early keenness that could compromise her stamina reserves over this extended trip
Guardian Of Realm's hood retention suggests ongoing settling issues that could derail any tactical advantage from the likely pace
Mandara Mist's market moves will reveal stable confidence in this well-bred but unproven newcomer making her debut
The pace development in the first half-mile will determine whether hold-up horses like Mai Dahlia get the setup they need
Purely's adaptation to blinkers and longer trip could unlock improvement for the Ballydoyle team
